ambiguities.text: The specification states TTD is 'a number to slightly exceed with the last POW block' but does not define exact boundary behavior
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the terminal block is the first block where cumulative total difficulty >= TERMINAL_TOTAL_DIFFICULTY. The parent block must have total difficulty < TTD.

ambiguities.text: The behavior during network partitions before first finalization is described as allowing recovery but lacks specific mechanisms
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume nodes maintain the ability to reorganize the chain following LMD-GHOST rules until first finalization. After finalization, the finalized block becomes immutable.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly define the behavior if a block's difficulty would cause total difficulty to exactly equal TTD
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume totalDifficulty == TTD triggers the transition, same as totalDifficulty > TTD. The block meeting or exceeding TTD is the terminal block.

implicit_assumptions.description: The beacon chain is correctly synchronized and provides accurate fork choice updates to the execution layer
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect fork choice updates could cause consensus splits between execution clients

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot accumulate enough hash power to reach TTD on a minority fork before the legitimate chain
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A malicious actor could trigger the merge on a fork they control, potentially disrupting network consensus

implicit_assumptions.description: All execution clients have accurate and consistent TERMINAL_TOTAL_DIFFICULTY configuration
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Clients with different TTD values would transition at different blocks, causing chain splits

implicit_assumptions.description: The Engine API connection between execution and consensus clients is reliable and low-latency
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network delays or connection failures could cause execution clients to miss fork choice updates or fall out of sync
